literal_meaning: এলো (আসা) + পাথাড়ি (পথে পথে অগ্রসর হওয়া, এলোমেলো ভাবে)
figurative_meaning_en: here and there; continuously or incessantly
example_sentences_in_english: The children are playing all over the place.
note: This idiom vividly captures erratic or scattered actions in everyday Bengali speech, reflecting a cultural flair for expressive onomatopoeia.
